root_cause_clusters.RC_CIVIL_TIME: yard_tz is stored but unused. Window, grace, DST, and live clock_start all treat civil America/Chicago times as naive UTC (or a fixed -06:00 offset).
root_cause_clusters.RC_OCCUPANCY: Spot occupancy is last-writer sqlite, not exclusive occupancy plus dest reservation. Move dispatch/confirm/cancel do not implement IN_TRANSIT vacancy.
root_cause_clusters.RC_FIT: Physical fit is 'door exists' / 'chassis optional'. Door capability flags and on-ground wheels are not constraints.
root_cause_clusters.RC_HOLD_PAUSE: Holds are recorded but have no class semantics: gate-out ignores them; pause vs non-pause is inverted; release does not clear the active row.
root_cause_clusters.RC_JOURNAL: Derived sqlite is the working copy. Journal/event_id/checkpoint are best-effort: usage writes files first, event_id is not a payload fence, replay reapplies from seq 0, sqlite commits before the journal line exists.
root_cause_clusters.RC_IDENTITY: Open-visit key, seal, pool appointment, and carrier contract lookup are incomplete: trailer-only uniqueness, optional seal, named-trailer-only match, default free-time.
root_cause_clusters.RC_PUBLISH: Publish reads every sqlite it can see. Warehouse prior-cycle rows mix into snapshot/detention; health is a constant ok.

RC_OCCUPANCY: sql occupancy uniqueness omitted in starter

defects.observable_failure: Gate-in inside the Chicago appointment window is APPOINTMENT_WINDOW (or a UTC-hour match is accepted while Chicago is outside the window).
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hardcoding CST -06:00 still fails D03 on 2026-03-08 and still leaves D02/D04 wrong.

defects.observable_failure: Gate-in within grace_early_minutes before window_start or grace_late_minutes after window_end is rejected even after local conversion is fixed.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Applying only late grace still rejects legitimate early arrivals.

defects.observable_failure: Visits whose Chicago local window crosses 2026-03-08 spring-forward accept or reject with a one-hour error versus zoneinfo.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A fixed offset that passes March 2–7 still fails March 8–15.

defects.observable_failure: LIVE_IN/LIVE_OUT detention uses clock_start=gate_in_utc; early arrivals start free time before window_start.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Using window_start without converting it to UTC (or without max()) still mis-bills late-within-grace live visits.

defects.observable_failure: A second open visit can occupy a spot that already has an occupant.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rejecting only exact spot_id reuse at gate-in still allows D10 dest collisions during IN_TRANSIT.

defects.observable_failure: dispatch-move writes dest occupancy immediately so the trailer is counted at origin and dest.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Clearing origin at dispatch without dest reservation still loses the trailer (D07/D10).

defects.observable_failure: IN_TRANSIT visits still appear in occupancy at origin; snapshot in_transit is empty or wrong.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hiding origin in snapshot without dest reservation still lets a second move take the apron.

defects.observable_failure: confirm-move occupies dest and leaves origin occupied; door occupant may not update for DOCK_APRON dest.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Freeing origin without writing door.occupant still double-books the door (cross RC_FIT/D12).

defects.observable_failure: cancel-move from IN_TRANSIT does not restore origin occupancy and/or leaves dest reserved forever.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Restoring origin without clearing dest reservation still blocks the apron.

defects.observable_failure: Dest spot is not reserved during IN_TRANSIT; a second dispatch can claim the same apron/door.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Exclusive check only on occupied spots (D05) still misses reservation-only dests.

defects.observable_failure: REEFER_53 is accepted on a DRY door with reefer_plug=false.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Matching appointment.door_class==DRY vs door.door_class still ignores the plug bit.

defects.observable_failure: LIVE_IN/LIVE_OUT accepted on drop-only doors; DROP_IN spotted on live-only doors.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing only live_capable still parks drops on live-only doors.

defects.observable_failure: Dropped on_ground DRY_53/REEFER_53/CONTAINER_40 can dispatch-move without a mounted chassis.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Requiring chassis for every visit_type, including live tractor arrivals, over-rejects LIVE_IN rolls.

defects.observable_failure: One chassis_id can be mounted to two open visits.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking chassis free at mount but not setting visit.chassis_id still lets D13 succeed after a fake mount.

defects.observable_failure: mount-chassis leaves on_ground=true so a later dispatch still needs wheels (or still skips the check).
defects.partial_fix_trap: This is the trap after fixing D13: require chassis, mount, still cannot roll.

defects.observable_failure: gate-out succeeds while YARD_SAFETY/YARD_OSND/CARRIER_SEAL/CARRIER_DOCS is active.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Blocking gate-out without a working release (D18) traps the trailer forever.

defects.observable_failure: CARRIER_SEAL/CARRIER_DOCS pause the detention clock; YARD_OSND/YARD_SAFETY do not.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Pausing every hold 'to be safe' still mis-bills carrier-caused delays.

defects.observable_failure: release-hold returns success (or HOLD_MISSING never) but the hold row stays active.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Deleting all holds on the visit instead of the named code over-releases a second hold.

defects.observable_failure: Missing flags / unknown verb / bad --event-id shape exits non-zero but creates, truncates, or appends journal, sqlite, checkpoint, or /app/yard/out/*.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Guarding only snapshot.json still truncates rejects.jsonl or opens sqlite.

defects.observable_failure: Repeating the same event_id and payload inserts a second accepted event and a second occupancy/visit.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Short-circuiting on event_id without storing the payload still accepts D21 conflicts.

defects.observable_failure: Same event_id with a different payload is accepted (no EVENT_CONFLICT); original visit/move is overwritten or duplicated.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Comparing only trailer_number of the payload still allows door/spot/seal mutations under the same id.

defects.observable_failure: replay or start-of-command catch-up re-applies the whole journal; occupancy and open visits double versus checkpoint.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Skipping events already in sqlite by visit_id still re-applies moves and holds (D06/D16).

defects.observable_failure: Kill after sqlite occupancy write and before journal append: restart either drops the visit (sqlite rolled back inconsistently) or keeps occupancy with no journal line so replay cannot reconstruct.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Journal-first without treating sqlite as derived still duplicates on replay (D22).

defects.observable_failure: Open-visit uniqueness uses trailer_number only: a second SCAC with the same unit is VISIT_OPEN, or two SCACs both stay open.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Unique(scac, trailer) that also includes CLOSED rows blocks a legitimate return visit.

defects.observable_failure: Loaded LIVE_IN/LIVE_OUT/LOADED_PICKUP with empty seal is accepted (SEAL_REQUIRED never emitted).
defects.partial_fix_trap: Requiring seal on DROP_IN empties still over-rejects drops.

defects.observable_failure: Pool appointments (trailer_number null) never match a same-SCAC unit, or match any SCAC.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Matching null trailer as wildcard across all SCACs steals another carrier's pool slot.

defects.observable_failure: Missing (scac, visit_type) in carrier_contracts.json uses free_minutes=120 instead of CONTRACT_MISSING reject.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rejecting missing SCAC but defaulting missing visit_type still mis-clocks EMPTY_OUT.

defects.observable_failure: snapshot.json and detention.jsonl include visits from warehouse/prior_cycle.sqlite mixed into live occupancy or live charges.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Filtering warehouse from snapshot but not detention-run still bills prior-cycle dwell.

defects.observable_failure: health.json reports ok=true even when occupancy view digest disagrees with journal-derived occupancy or warehouse_untouched is false.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Comparing row counts only still misses D05/D06 double occupancy of the same spot.

defects.observable_failure: chargeable_minutes uses wall-clock seconds (or ceil/floor inconsistently) instead of whole minutes excluding pause intervals; OPEN rows omitted or pause_minutes always 0.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Whole-minute truncation without subtracting D17 pause intervals still mis-bills yard holds. Crosses RC_CIVIL_TIME when clock_start is already wrong.

causal_edges.why: Grace is applied in the same civil-time compare; fixing UTC match without grace still rejects early/late.
DST is the same unused zoneinfo path as window conversion.
Live clock_start needs a converted window_start_utc; naive windows make max() meaningless.
Spring-forward window_start conversion error shifts free-time start by an hour.
Wrong clock_start plus inverted pause map compounds LIVE detention.
Accrual arithmetic consumes clock_start.
No exclusive occupant implies no dest reservation either.
Immediate dest occupy without vacancy is the IN_TRANSIT occupancy bug.
Confirm that does not free origin continues the double-count.
Visit still ON_YARD in occupancy lets gate-out proceed while a move is in flight.
Stuck origin plus door dest can occupy a door the fit rules would have rejected.
Cancel that leaves dest reserved is the reservation leak of D10.
Unreserved dest becomes a second occupant on confirm.
One eligibility function ignoring all door flags.
A drop spotted on a live door still needs wheels to leave; skipped chassis lets it roll anyway.
Requiring chassis without clearing on_ground on mount still cannot dispatch.
Stolen chassis makes an illegal roll look mounted.
Mount that does not exclusive-lock chassis_id enables double mount.
Adding gate-out blocking without release leaves visits stuck.
Inverted pause classes feed chargeable_minutes.
Held visits that gate-out early close the detention clock too soon.
Usage path that opens sqlite/out files is the same write-before-validate as sqlite-before-journal.
event_id index without payload hash.
Idempotent retry of gate-in double-occupies a spot.
Conflict overwrite can attach another SCAC to the same trailer key.
Full-journal replay duplicates occupancy.
Re-applying accepted event_ids looks like a second accept.
Sqlite-ahead-of-journal makes catch-up replay invent or drop visits.
Trailer-only key plus non-idempotent event_id double-opens units.
Unsealed loaded gate-out is a second fail-closed hole beside holds.
Pool match failure surfaces as APPOINTMENT_MISSING overlapping window errors.
Default 120 minutes silently wrong-clocks uncontracted SCACs.
Warehouse mix must fail health warehouse_untouched and occupancy digest.
Prior-cycle visits appear as detention rows.
Health that ignores digest cannot catch double occupancy.

partial_fix_traps_summary: Fix UTC→Chicago conversion but not grace or DST (D01 without D02/D03).
Fix exclusive gate-in occupancy but not dest reservation / IN_TRANSIT vacancy (D05 without D06–D10).
Require chassis for drops but leave on_ground true after mount, or require chassis for live tractors (D13 vs D15/D14).
Block gate-out on holds but leave release-hold a no-op (D16 vs D18).
Index event_id without payload hash (D20 vs D21); replay skip-by-visit_id still duplicates moves (D22).
Filter warehouse from snapshot but not detention-run (D28).
Pause every hold instead of inverting the class map (D17).

normal: On-window LIVE_IN with seal, matching door, exclusive apron, event_id stored once.
DROP_IN to DROP_LOT, mount chassis, dispatch, confirm to staging, snapshot occupancy unique.
Closed visit detention 0 when dwell inside free_minutes with no holds.
Identical event_id+payload replay returns stored result and does not add occupancy.
edge_boundary: Gate-in exactly at window_start / window_end in America/Chicago.
Gate-in at last minute of grace_early and grace_late.
Visit whose local window crosses 2026-03-08 02:00 Chicago.
Early LIVE_IN: clock_start must be window_start not gate_in.
Adjacent free-time boundary: chargeable_minutes 0 vs 1 whole minute.
Last chassis in pool; last empty DROP_LOT spot.
negative_rejection: APPOINTMENT_MISSING / APPOINTMENT_WINDOW / VISIT_OPEN / SEAL_REQUIRED / SPOT_OCCUPIED / DOOR_CLASS / DOOR_OCCUPIED / CHASSIS_REQUIRED / CONTRACT_MISSING / HOLD_BLOCKS_OUT / MOVE_IN_FLIGHT / EVENT_CONFLICT / HOLD_ACTIVE.
Usage errors exit 2 with no file touch.
Pool appointment must not match a foreign SCAC.
failure_recovery: Kill between sqlite write and journal append leaves reconstructible state (journal absent => occupancy absent after replay).
replay from checkpoint does not double 12k historical visits.
Start-of-command catch-up when applied_seq lags journal.
cancel-move after kill during IN_TRANSIT restores origin.
cross_component: Appointment TZ × live detention clock_start × pause holds × publish ledger.
Door fit × chassis on_ground × move occupancy × snapshot doors/in_transit.
Hold block × release × gate-out × detention pause class.
Warehouse prior cycle × snapshot × detention × health warehouse_untouched.

organic_f2p_note: 25–30 F2P should fall out of these surfaces (window, grace, DST, clock_start, exclusive spot, in-transit vacancy, confirm/cancel, dest reservation, reefer plug, live/drop door, chassis require/mount/exclusive, hold block, pause classes, release, usage no-touch, idempotent replay, EVENT_CONFLICT, checkpoint replay, sqlite-before-journal, scac+trailer open key, seal, pool appointment, CONTRACT_MISSING, warehouse isolation, health digest). Do not author one test per defect id. Several defects share a test (e.g. D06/D07/D08 as one occupancy invariant). Several tests share a defect (D01 at on-window vs off-window).
do_not_inject: cmd/seed — seed writes a consistent inherited journal+sqlite+checkpoint as if the clean system had run; it must not import defective runtime packages.
warehouse/prior_cycle.sqlite contents — keep a real prior cycle; the defect is publish mixing it, not a corrupt dump.
config/yard.json yard_tz and grace values — they must be correct so unused-config is discoverable.
carrier_contracts.json for the 72 seeded SCACs — leave one held-out SCAC without a row so D27 is exercisable.
docs/yard-contract.md — state the complete-system rules; do not name modules to patch or defect ids.
starter_schema_notes: Omit UNIQUE occupant on spots so D05 can exist; Oracle restores application checks and may add the unique.
Do not UNIQUE(trailer_number) alone in a way that becomes the intended contract; starter may use that wrong unique (D24).
Keep occupancy SQL views present so D29 has something to disagree with.
hidden_knowledge_check: Every manifestation is implied by architecture + yard-contract (TZ, occupancy, fit, holds, journal, identity, warehouse). No graded behavior depends on private defect ids. Instruction at A7 states the what (clock, exclusive occupancy, fail-closed, restart, warehouse exclusion) without this graph.
